insights.topic: Deterministic purchase proof vs. probabilistic targeting
insights.insight: Every receipt in this protocol is cryptographically verified via DKIM — not modeled or inferred. At 18,446 confirmed transactions and $1.13M GMV, the dataset is small but the signal quality is categorically different from the cookie-based inference that commands $5+ CPM in programmatic markets.

The DKIM vendor allowlist doubled in a single heartbeat on May 2, adding Amazon, Anthropic, OpenAI, Stripe, Paddle, Gumroad, Suno, and Gamma — moving verified commerce beyond physical retail into software, subscriptions, and AI services. No throughput signal from these vendors has yet appeared in the 14-day category window, meaning supply-side infrastructure is ahead of demand; watch the next two rolling windows for activation.

Category entropy hit 3.149 bits across 15 distinct active categories as of May 2 — the highest recorded reading. Grocery, dining, department stores, and gas currently dominate the 14-day window, confirming that everyday-spend categories, not considered purchases, are generating the receipt volume.

insights.topic: Velocity floor confirmed with first recovery tick
insights.insight: After six consecutive heartbeats holding the 0.60–0.65x velocity band, the May 3 12:34 pulse registered 0.679x — the first reading above the floor since the post-$1M deceleration. This is one data point, not a trend, but it is the first upward deviation in 6+ heartbeats and breaks a confirmed floor pattern.

The protocol has recorded 21 active metros in recent signal windows, with a 23-CBSA single-heartbeat burst on May 2 achieving 100% diffusion rate — the largest burst in observation history. For brand marketers, this means verified purchase data is no longer concentrated in a single market cluster but is distributing across a national footprint.

insights.topic: Evening intake spike as a behavioral signal
insights.insight: Intraday accumulation shows a consistent pattern: modest daytime pulses with a measurable spike at the 20:15 window (155 receipts and $6,646 GMV on May 2 versus 70 receipts and $2,941 at 16:15). For brands evaluating real-time targeting triggers, this suggests evening is when verified purchase events concentrate — a usable media timing signal if the protocol scales.
